question: How long can FD003-A100 keep flying and what is wrong with it?

documents.heading: Fan blades: inspection and blend limits

claims.text: Remaining useful life is about 27 cycles (10th-90th percentile 20-125) by the ML model; the health-index trend gives 10.
Most likely fault mode: Fan degradation (probability 1.00).
Sensors pulling the RUL estimate down most: Nc (hpc), NRc (hpc), htBleed (hpc).

3 similar past removals in case memory (FD003-H019 at cycle 229, FD003-H027 at cycle 320, FD003-H042 at cycle 193); the shop found fan blade leading edges eroded and case liner rub on all 3, after removal for performance deterioration.
Recommended, needs engineering approval: SB-TF-72-0157 3.B (service bulletin, compliance recommended, no fleet decision yet).
Reference: SB-TF-72-0157 1.A (service bulletin, background to the bulletin, no action in this section); AMM-TF-R3 72-21-00 (manual); AMM-TF-R3 05-20-00 (manual).
Sensors that distinguish Fan degradation from the other candidate are P30, phi, BPR, W31, W32 (not the SHAP drivers, which move under both modes).

recommendation.action: Swap in lease engine; module shop visit on the removed engine

rationale.text: Deadline 2026-10-23 is the RUL lower bound 3 cycles at 2 cycles/day.
Trigger severity severe: planning lower bound 3 cycles (min(A 10th percentile 20, B lower 3); severe < 25, moderate < 80).

Selected tasks need TF-FAN-2101 (need 1, 0 on hand, 75 d lead), TF-FAN-2103 (need 1, 2 on hand, 28 d lead), TF-GEN-8102 (need 1, 30 on hand, 5 d lead), TF-ENG-9001 (need 1, 1 on hand, 21 d lead). Short: TF-FAN-2101. In-stock substitutes do not replace a short required part.

RUL lower bound 1.4 days is shorter than the time to repair on wing: short parts TF-FAN-2101 need 75 d lead time plus next free slot 1 d; swap a lease engine and do the shop visit on the removed engine.
World Model task FM-FAN-04: Swap in lease engine; module shop visit on the removed engine.
World Model task FM-FAN-03: Remove engine; replace fan blade set and case abradable liner.
Limits and intervals for FM-FAN-03 follow AMM-TF-R3 72-21-00 (manual); SB-TF-72-0157 3.B (service bulletin) also covers it: SB recommended; adopting it needs engineering approval.

Work package (asset-pack templates, synthetic task references): engine change at the first free slot 2026-10-23 (9 tasks, 3 RII, 30 manhours); module shop visit induction on the removed engine, in the shop (4 tasks, 0 RII, 24 manhours); before installing the lease engine, verify 5 items Cleris has no data on; 54 manhours in all.
World Model lists tasks for this fault (FM-FAN-01, FM-FAN-02, FM-FAN-03, FM-FAN-04); the plan uses FM-FAN-04, FM-FAN-03.

World Model links these document sections to tasks for this fault: AMM-TF-R3 71-00-00→FM-HPC-06, AMM-TF-R3 72-21-00→FM-FAN-01, SB-TF-72-0157 3.B→FM-FAN-01; which apply now and which are mandatory is decided by the knowledge agent.

agents.name: intake
agents.role: Reads the question and resolves the engine, or asks back

agents.name: planner
agents.role: Assigns round 1, delegates follow-ups the findings call for, routes each gap to the agent that can fix it

agents.name: data
agents.role: Telemetry, input plausibility, history, schedule, slots, entered inspection findings; inspection history and targeted re-queries

agents.name: prognostics
agents.role: RUL methods A and B, SHAP drivers, anomaly flag; back-test at the last inspection

agents.name: diagnostics
agents.role: Fault-mode match and similar past cases; checks both candidates when unclear; checks an inspection finding against the fault mode

agents.name: knowledge
agents.role: Applicable documents in precedence order, mandates decided in code; the limit section for each inspection finding, compared in code; binds a missing mandate

agents.name: maint_planner
agents.role: Task, parts, slot and deadline from the RUL lower bound; applies the routed fixes

agents.name: rule_checks
agents.role: Deterministic gate: citations, numbers, parts, slots, deadlines, mandates

agents.name: critic
agents.role: Deterministic checks, then Nemotron challenges that code confirms or refutes

agents.name: escalation
agents.role: Deterministic escalation rules from the asset pack
